dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.zfighter_op: Another one. Stand where I can see you.
Your name is already in my book. Mine is no matter. Speak.
Don't fidget. Everyone fidgets here. What is it?
You climbed a long way to stand here. Catch your breath first.
The wind said someone was coming. Welcome to the Lookout.
Sit, if you like. Up here, nobody is in a hurry.
A visitor! Mind the beans. What do you want?
Ha! Still standing after that ladder? I'm impressed.
Don't touch anything bubbling. Now, what brings you up my tower?
Don't touch that. Or that. What do you want?
Ah, a test subject! I mean, a guest. Hello.
Mind the wires. Speak up, the machines are loud.
You made it to the end of the road. Most give up halfway.
Breathe slowly, fighter. The air is thin this far along.
So the Judge sent you on. Good. Sit, and listen.
I knew you would come. The ball told me. Sit.
Your fortune is cloudy today. Let's see what we can do.
Ah, the one the cards keep turning up. Welcome.
You smell of the world above. What do you want down here?
Few walk in here on purpose. Speak, before I lose interest.
Brave, or foolish. We'll find out which soon enough.
You're not from around here, are you? Neither am I.
Easy. I'm only looking. Everything here is so... old.
Hello. Your clothes are strange. What do you want?
Patrol business. Keep it short, citizen.
At ease. Anything to report?
Stay out of trouble and we'll get along fine. What is it?
Careful where you step. It isn't done cooling.
Another one who saw it fall. Come, look.
The sky dropped something. People always come to see what.
Mind the heat. What did you bring me?
Nobody walks this far for the view.
Your wrist was humming the whole way here. I heard it.
Keep your hands where I can see them. Both of them.
You've got the look of someone who wears something they shouldn't.
Mine hums when yours is near. Did you know that?
